exposure: transvaginal aspiration during pregnancy for endometrioma diagnosed in the first trimester
cohort: 31 pregnant women with endometrioma: 8 who underwent transvaginal cyst aspiration at 12-14 weeks and 23 who refused aspiration
finding: The group that underwent transvaginal cyst aspiration tended to have lower rates of preterm deliveries and emergency cesarean sections compared to the observation group.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section rate during delivery was 14.2% in the aspiration group and 43.7% in the observation group.
